title: Iswrni onnajwng, rupati fwrbwao
lyrics:
Ch,
Iswrni onnajwng, rupati fwrbwao
Sofwinw hanai, gaswi alasi
Gaham onsainanwi, gugrup kulumnanwi
"Boraiyw maninang alasi fwrkhou" -2

-A-

Dhwrwmiya jiu khangnw, jwngkhou fwrwngdw
Swithw lama thabainw, tulunga hwdw-2
Thwiso thangso oraibw
Swithwni lamao thabaigwn -2

-B-

Rongja rongja de rongja, dinwini sanao
Rongjabaogwn mabwla, dinwi nongabla-2
Phorbunao jwng rongjayw bla
Swrgwao arpho rongjayw -2
